title: What became of it
lede: The stores, the debt and the jobs are gone. The name, the giraffe and the jingle were the only assets the lenders chose to keep.

items.title: The name
items.text: Controlled since March 2021 by WHP Global, a brand management firm, alongside funds managed by Solus and Ares.[^23] It appears on shops inside Macy’s, a flagship at American Dream in New Jersey, and stores operated with Go! Retail Group.[^24][^25][^26][^27]

items.title: The U.S. stores
items.text: All 735 were put into liquidation in March 2018 and the last closed on June 29, 2018.[^14][^16] The Times Square flagship had already closed in December 2015.[^36]

items.title: The workers
items.text: More than 30,000 lost their jobs without severance.[^16][^18] The $20M fund set up by KKR and Bain Capital was open to those with at least a year of tenure and annual income between $5,000 and $110,000.[^17] Vornado is not named in the fund’s announcement.[^17]

items.title: The founder
items.text: Charles Lazarus died on March 22, 2018, a week after the wind-down was announced. He was 94.[^29][^30]

items.title: The idea
items.text: The new stores are a fraction of the old ones. The 2019 stores were about 6,500 square feet, “about one-seventh of the size of the old Toys R Us stores,” and a 2026 store near Boston is about 5,000.[^22][^27] The toy supermarket, as a format, has not come back.

blocks.title: Who has owned the name
blocks.subtitle: Six owners in seventy years. Two of the changes of hands happened in bankruptcy court.

nodes.what: Opens the first store under the Toys “R” Us name.[^5][^29]
Buys the four-store chain. Lazarus stays to run it.[^31]
The parent fails; the toy division carries the reorganized company, which is renamed Toys “R” Us, Inc.[^31]
Take the public company private at $26.75 a share.[^3]
The U.S. business is liquidated. The trademark auction is canceled and the lenders keep the brand.[^13][^14][^19]
The lenders’ new company relaunches the website and opens two stores, which close in January 2021.[^21][^22]
Acquires a controlling interest and licenses the name to Macy’s and store operators.[^23][^25][^27]

blocks.source: 10-K filings[^3][^5], reference history[^31], 8-Ks[^13][^14] and press as cited.
